system.description:
• Effect: Pay for Metamagic (see below) by sacrificing temporary points from Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution.
  • Spellburn never changes your HP or your death threshold, and burned points return at 1 per attribute each day.
  • Guaranteed, no roll, no Corruption risk.
  • The cost doubles with each Spellburn you make in a day: your first burn costs 1 point for the base effect, your second 2, your third 4, your fourth 8, and so on.
  • The enhanced effect costs double the base for that burn (2, then 4, then 8, then 16).
  • Unlike Wild Surge it has no daily limit, only what your body can afford.
  • Spellburn cannot reduce an attribute below 1. One Metamagic option per spell (two during Sorcerer's Spark)

activities.name: Spellburn
activities.text: Pay for Metamagic by burning Strength, Dexterity or Constitution: 1 point for your first burn each day, then 2, 4, 8 (the enhanced effect costs double). Burned points return at 1 per attribute each day; never below 1.
